answer: Decay runs at 3% per epoch for identities with 0 tasks, and a failed audit slashes 25% of stake. Edge case: a farm rotates 1,000 identities through 1 task each to dodge the zero-task trigger, so the decay has to read tasks attempted, not tasks paid. With that fix, 1,000 identities x 1 task = 1,000 audits at 25% slash risk, or 250 stakes burned to earn one pearl-sized payout; the crystal settlement cost per clone exceeds the ocean of fees 1,000 clones can earn in an epoch.
